profile.intro: I am a researcher in computer science. My work focuses on applying machine learning to problems in security and biomedical data. I am always glad to hear from students and collaborators with related interests.
profile.statement: My research develops reliable machine learning methods and applies them to real problems. I am interested in how learning systems can be made robust, how they can help defend information systems, and how they can support analysis of biological and medical data.
